title: WOLFSSL_CRYPTO2DEV_HASH_REPLAY_COPY referenced in comment but never implemented
description: What is unclear: The WC_ALGO_TYPE_COPY handler (port.c lines 1547-1588) contains the comment 'Option A (transcript replay buffer) is available via WOLFSSL_CRYPTO2DEV_HASH_REPLAY_COPY at a cost of O(transcript) memory per hash object.' No such #ifdef exists anywhere in the codebase. A contributor reading this comment will define WOLFSSL_CRYPTO2DEV_HASH_REPLAY_COPY and see no behavior change, then file a bug or waste hours tracing the missing code. Fix: either remove the reference or replace it with a clearly marked TODO comment explaining what the implementation would require.
